description:
Disjoint workflow and verification children implement the authenticated candidate-to-publication protocol by composing accepted authority and producer interfaces.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Versioned transition, root, escrow, rehearsal, and compact tag-manifest schemas define every exact identity and crash/recovery boundary before workflow implementations consume them.
- [hard] REQ-02: Candidate handoff/validation/producer/root, immutable escrow, clean-room rehearsal, final-tag, npm, GHCR, and final-GitHub workflows are independently owned and use least privilege, exact-ID authentication, overwrite-forbidden evidence, and no source rebuild or mutable discovery.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every final mutator and recovery path shares literal `jit-v1.0.0-publication` with `cancel-in-progress:false`; prepared/live-readback/completed ordering and Actions-410 recovery reconcile immutable escrow, tag manifest, and exact live state.
- [hard] REQ-04: Cross-workflow acceptance proves serialization, pending replacement behavior, no running cancellation, fresh absent-tag authorization, exact-existing-tag recovery, endpoint isolation, and denial of mismatch, unsafe retry, or precondition bypass.
- [hard] REQ-05: The story's children exclusively own release-execution workflow YAML, protocol schemas, and hosted cross-workflow fixtures; they do not duplicate account-side configuration or producer primitive implementation.

## Notes

Blast radius: the `story:release-orchestration` child set; source freeze and all public release operations remain downstream execution work.
title: Implement gated candidate, rehearsal, tag, and publication orchestration
